dedupe_keys.name: renewable electricity supply and storage in europe restore

description: Renewable Electricity Supply and Storage in Europe (RESTORE) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Wuppertal Institut;. Optimised dispatch of flexibility options (Storage, Demand Side Management, Transmission grid). Minimising and leveling backup eneregy (non renewable energy). Europe, temporal and spatial resolution are adaptable (min resolution: countrywise, hourly). Coverage: Europe and North africa (32 countries). Time resolution: hour. Spatial resolution: national states. Software: Matlab, R. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
